methodology.testUsage: TEST reserved exclusively for final evaluation of the selected model
methodology.missingData: Missing values are imputed inside each training pipeline/fold.
methodology.deduplication: Exact duplicate local rows are removed before source merging and splitting; cross-source patient duplicates are resolved conservatively.
methodology.imbalanceHandling: Random oversampling balances TRAIN and each CV fold only; VALIDATION and TEST retain their observed class distribution. Tree/linear estimators also use native balanced class weights where supported.
methodology.eligibility: Mandatory filters are macro sensitivity >= 0.70, minimum class sensitivity >= 0.50, specificity >= 0.70, MCC >= 0.40, balanced accuracy >= 0.70, ROC-AUC >= 0.70 and macro F1 >= 0.60. Precision, Kappa and Accuracy are informational with a 0.00 floor.
methodology.selectionRanking: Among eligible candidates: macro sensitivity, minimum class sensitivity, specificity, MCC, balanced accuracy, ROC-AUC, macro F1, precision, Kappa and Accuracy (descending); normalizedQuality and CV scores are informational only.
methodology.selectionFallback: If no candidate meets every required metric, no candidate is selected or published; an already-published model is retained only if its recorded validation metrics meet the current requirements.
